notes: A full-session horizon counts sessions after the first-tradable session, avoiding a near-zero holding period for filings observed near the close.
The target for a session horizon is one second before the recorded regular-session close; no missing quote may be imputed.
Plans activate only after a genuinely new filing has both an integrity-cleared document package and first-tradable quote evidence.
Return observations are market measurements, not positions, orders, executions, or paper fills.
VOO quote-price return is recorded directly, then a separate reconciler may label total-return excess only after immutable corporate-action and independent official schedule evidence pass.
